name: Fresh Canna Live Resin | Pineapple Express
description: Get ready to ride the wave of tropical euphoria with Fresh Canna’s Live Resin Wax – Pineapple Express. This premium extract is crafted from fresh-frozen, top-tier cannabis, preserving the full-spectrum flavors and potent effects that true connoisseurs crave. Bursting with juicy pineapple, citrus, and earthy pine notes, this sativa-dominant concentrate delivers a smooth, flavorful dab that hits fast and hard. Expect an uplifting cerebral rush followed by a mellow, creative buzz—perfect for powering through the day with high-energy vibes and tropical freshness.
